what_it_does: Takes complex astrophysical simulations that model how thousands or millions of objects (stars, planets, black holes) move and interact under gravity — computationally expensive calculations that predict motion in space over time — and ports them to a specialized acceleration processor called Wormhole that uses the RISC-V instruction set architecture (an open-source processor design). The work benchmarks this accelerator against highly optimized traditional computer processor baselines to demonstrate performance improvements.
